high_level_description: The image is a collage of four photographs featuring Princess Diana running on a grassy field. The setting appears to be an outdoor sports field, likely part of a school or similar institution, as suggested by the presence of other individuals in the background who seem to be participating in the same event. In the main photograph, Princess Diana is captured mid-stride, wearing a black top with a brown belt and a long, flowing skirt that is lifted up by her movement. Her hair is styled in a voluminous, classic 1980s fashion.
